title: OAM: Add support for missing DPoE and 1904.1 attributes
description:
Add support for several DPoE and IEEE 1904.1 OAM attributes and
enhanced the decoding of several others.

notes.body:
can you fix also

```
packet-oampdu.c:2408:17: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
packet-oampdu.c:2411:17: warning: Value stored to 'offset' is never read [deadcode.DeadStores]
```

typo ?

Field 'Object Type' (oampdu.vendor.specific.dpoe.evt.object_type) has a conflicting entry in its value_string: 1 is at indices 1 (Network PON Port) and 3 (User Port)
Fixed. I also changed the name of this array to a more general name since it is used in more than one place.
